body.statement: The full compatible effect fiber has the exact representation \(\Theta_{TY}(\Gamma,\preceq)=\{\beta_J(\Gamma):J\in\mathcal J\}\). Moreover, it is a singleton if and only if \(\gamma_{TW\cdot(D\cup J)}(\Gamma)\gamma_{YW\cdot(D\cup J\cup\{T\})}(\Gamma)=0\) for every ideal edge \(J\to J\cup\{W\}\).
body.justification: The proposition replaces a factorial order list by the exact treatment-predecessor lattice and exposes all effect-collision strata.
body.gap: Sanjaroonpouri--Ramazi bounds the number of equivalent SCMs and Perkovi\'c--Kalisch--Maathuis enumerates possible effects, but neither inspected source gives this ideal-indexed equality or local singleton certificate.
body.consumer: The representation is the population specification needed by an IDA-style effect report under a known partial order.
